[LTAC.4.1] Synthetic timer facts are engine-managed, and their schemas have
synthetic names ([LLEX.10.6.1]). Author code cannot pattern-match a timer fact
directly: no source text can write a `$Timer_…` name.

idris.name: ltac_3_2__capture_timer
idris.note: The timer's kind, which no author pattern names: the lowering alone allocates it. LESS than the clause: the prohibition is the lowering's, the model has the kind.
